description: HW1-PIPE-v1 outer channel, inner protocol v2, X1: complete encrypted sessions from the CCCD write to the phone's PAUSED reset, one per ATT MTU. Relay streams, the console stream (slot 2) with every record type, LINK_STATE both ways and every console CLOSE reason. Synthetic passphrase, keys, targets and content; never device credentials.
generated_by: components/hardwareone/test/host/phone_session_vectors.cpp: production BLE_PhoneGatt.cpp, BLE_PhoneSecureChannel.h, BLE_PhonePipeCore.h and BLE_PhonePipeConsoleCore.h on the synthetic SDK in phone_gatt_fake_sdk.h; only the device key, secure nonce and pipe HELLO nonce are fixed
script: secure HELLO, HELLO_ACK, CONFIRM, CONFIRM_ACK; pipe HELLO (counter 1, seq 0, flags 1) and HELLO_ACK (flags 3)
console stream 1: OPEN (limit 4096, port 1, type 4), OPEN_OK 4096, INFO (98 bytes); phone COMMAND status, P4 TEXT (26 bytes)
relay stream 2: OPEN IPv4, OPEN_OK 1024; P4 queues 1100 relay bytes, a 1300-byte BLOB chain and its TEXT header at once: relay, relay, relay, then console
P4 CARD and 600 bytes of MIRROR; phone BINARY (489 bytes); five idle seconds with the relay open: P4 PING, phone PONG
phone sends 300 relay bytes and FIN 300; P4 CLOSE 0, phone CLOSE_ACK; relay stream 3: OPEN IPv6, OPEN_OK 1024, 40 bytes up, P4 CLOSE 1, phone CLOSE_ACK
relay stream 4: OPEN DNS, phone OPEN_ERR 16 and LINK_STATE 2; phone COMMAND uptime, P4 TEXT
P4 LINK_STATE 0, its last TEXT, then CLOSE 3 after drain; one second later LINK_STATE 1 and console stream 5
phone COMMAND with MORE: P4 CLOSE 1; console stream 6 after 2 s: a 1500-byte TEXT chain cut by ABORT after one record; CLOSE 2 and console stream 7 at once
phone LINK_STATE 0: P4 CLOSE 4; one second later phone LINK_STATE 2: console stream 8; CLOSE 5 and console stream 9 at once
sixty idle seconds with only the console: no PING at 5 s, P4 PING at 60 s, phone PONG; phone RESET 18 (PAUSED) ends the session
phone_rules: reads every DATA byte at once and grants consumed + 4096 (relay and console alike), once that is at least 512 B past its last grant or 100 ms after it
answers PING with PONG and the P4's CLOSE with CLOSE_ACK at once; PINGs after 5 s without a P4 frame while a relay stream it accepted is open (it never did here: the P4's RX went quiet first)
sends queued control frames first, in order, then DATA round-robin within the P4's credit
one notification at a time, at least 30 ms apart; the P4's writes complete 10 ms after submission
answers a console OPEN with OPEN_OK at once and a relay OPEN after a 100 ms TCP connect; OPEN_ERR, FIN, LINK_STATE, RESET, COMMAND and BINARY are the script's

fields.t_ms: P4 adapter clock relative to its CCCD write submission
fields.att: write_request = TX CCCD write; write_cmd = RX write without response; notify = TX notification
fields.counter: outer DATA counter (big endian on the wire); per direction, strictly increasing
fields.inner_hex: decrypted 12-byte pipe header (byte 0 = 2) plus body; seq is per direction and contiguous from 0
fields.class: link (stream 0), relay (slots 0-1), console (slot 2, OPEN address type 4), unopened
fields.console_records: console records in the order their receiver completed them: the phone (PhoneReceiver) for p4_to_phone, the P4 (scanIngress) for phone_to_p4; payload_hex is empty for a malformed record
fields.p4_end: how the P4 adapter ended the session: core error, peer_reset (a phone stream-0 RESET), phase, auth_cooldown, strike (a version-mismatch strike)
fields.info_utf8: the INFO payload the P4 writes in these sessions (synthetic fw and model)
fields.stream ids: one increasing id space for relay and console streams
